name: docs-sweep
description: Audit and update documentation across an entire project, with optional Project Knowledge Graph integration.

interface.shortDescription: Refresh documentation across a whole project.
interface.longDescription: Audit and update project-wide documentation against current repository evidence, validate the result, and use an existing project knowledge graph when available.
defaultPrompt: Bring every project document in sync with the code.
Find and fix stale setup, API, and operations docs.
Sweep the docs and refresh the existing project graph.
